text:
emma_sales: Quick ask from FinLedger procurement — they want a SOC 2 summary, ISO scope confirmation, and a pen-test attestation letter for the POC. They want a bundle by EOD tomorrow. Can we assemble?

raj_se: I can pull the POC infra artifacts (topology diagram, network isolation notes, sample kube policy). Need to know if POC runs on Hosted or Dedicated — affects what screenshots we include.

noah_grc: We have a SOC 2 summary + ISO scope doc in the compliance repo. I can redact and pull the Type II cover letter. Pen-test attestation needs Security sign-off.

liam_security: I can draft the pen-test attestation template. Questions: do they accept a vendor-attestation (our signed letter stating no critical findings at time X) or do they require a third-party report? Template draft below I can fill in:

```
Penetration Test Attestation
Vendor: Redwood Inference
Customer: FinLedger (POC)
Scope: Redwood production services used for POC (dedicated dev pool)
Test window: [date range]
Summary: No known critical or high vulnerabilities affecting confidentiality/integrity/availability discovered during the test window.
Signed: Security Lead
```

emma_sales: They wrote: "third-party pen test letter or equivalent" — legal prefers a vendor-signed attestation if it's not feasible to ship a full 3rd-party report for the POC. POC start date is Mon 03/30.

raj_se: For Dedicated POC we can export these artifacts: topology.pdf, tenant-isolation-screenshots.png, kms-policy-snippet.txt, siem-retention.png. I’ll stage them in the Sales/FinLedger folder.

noah_grc: Uploaded SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf and ISO_scope_statement.md to the shared drive (Sales/FinLedger). Link: https://redwood.app/drive/finledger/compliance (internal). Liam — if you can drop the pen-test attestation by 10am tomorrow I’ll package everything.

liam_security: I’ll have a draft by 10am. If FinLedger insists on an independent third-party report we need to offer a timeline/cost impact — ping Legal and Sales if that comes up.

sara_support: I’ll create an evidence checklist and assemble the ZIP (asset inventory, config screenshots, KMS policy, SOC2 summary, ISO scope, pen-test attestation, SIEM retention screenshots). ETA 2pm tomorrow.

emma_sales: :thumbsup: Thanks — I’ll confirm with FinLedger whether vendor-attestation is acceptable and post back. If they require third-party, we’ll coordinate next steps here.

deploybot: deploy-bot: uploaded Sales/FinLedger/compliance_bundle_draft_v1.zip (2.1MB) to internal-files.

liam_security: Note for package — ensure no sensitive customer data in screenshots, redact any tenant IDs. I’ll include a signed PDF once finalized.

emma_sales: Great. I’ll send a heads-up to FinLedger now and let them know we can deliver the bundle by tomorrow afternoon pending their confirmation on attestation vs 3rd-party.

noah_grc: Tagging legal if they chime in: @legal_team — please advise on standard language for vendor-attestation vs third-party requirement.

emma_sales: (adding in FinLedger contact) — will update thread when they reply.
